integrity: The universal statements follow from the analytic ratio identity and sharp scalar maximum; independent external review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Two strictly interior latent success probabilities and a fixed common integer trial count n>=2; no generalization to arbitrary mixing measures or unequal trial counts is established. Finite exact-rational checks are supplementary, not an infinite-domain certificate. Earlier equivalent formulations under other terminology remain a priority risk.
title: Sharp odds-gap thresholds for log-concavity of two-point binomial mixtures
